name: Buenos Aires rental market data
description: Monthly aggregated rental prices by neighborhood and bedroom count. Compares Airbnb to direct-rental market across all major platforms. Prices are all-in US dollars: base rent, expensas, utilities, guarantee and broker fee amortized monthly.
citeAs: Unitrank (August 2026). Buenos Aires rental market data. Retrieved from https://unitrank.com/en/methodology. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.

methodologyNotes.priceTrimming: Bottom 10% and top 20% of prices removed on the pooled distribution before aggregation.
methodologyNotes.furnishedDetection: Based on visible bed count in listing photos (LLM-extracted total_bed_capacity > 0). Coverage approximately 61%.
allInIncludes: Broker fee amortized over contract duration, where charged
Guarantee (seguro de caución) amortized monthly, where charged
allInExcludes: Stamp tax (sellado, one-time, approximately 0.5% of contract)
